## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new capability
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `chore`: docs, tests, refactor, CI, dependencies
- [ ] Breaking change (also add `!` to the title and the `breaking-change` label)

## How was it tested?

<!-- Commands you ran and what you observed. Write "N/A" with a reason if nothing to test. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows `<type>/<issue-number>-<description>`
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and end with the `Signed-off-by` (DCO) and `Co-authored-by` trailers
- [ ] The change is small and focused on one thing
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `go test -race ./...` passes
- [ ] Security review done (`.claude/skills/security-review/SKILL.md`)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Labels set: one `type/` label and at least one `area/` label
